preamble: Labial palatalization of [b] to the voiced palatal stop [ɟ] before front vowels is a regional feature of Daco-Romanian dialects, above all the Moldavian dialect, where the labials [p, b, m] before front vowels are realized as [c, ɟ, ɲ]. Spelled ghi- in dialect writing (ghine for standard bine 'well'), it is a well-known stereotype of Moldavian speech but is not found in standard Romanian.

examples.note: Before front vowels the labials [p, b, m] are palatalized and become [c, ɟ, ɲ] in Moldavian speech (also picior > k'icior 'leg', miere > n'ere 'honey'); Wikipedia transcribes the bine example as [ˈɡʲini].

sources: Guia, S. (2020). Palatalizarea consoanelor labiale în româna vorbită dialectală. Proceedings of the International Conference "Communication, Context, Interdisciplinarity" 6, 329–339. https://diacronia.ro/en/indexing/details/A32452
